characters: Dr. Seward is the narrator (the chapter is his diary)
Mrs. (Mina) Harker is present and leads the conversation
Jonathan Harker, her husband, sits beside her
Van Helsing and Quincey are present; Lucy is only mentioned
characters_main: Names Mina (Mrs. Harker) as the most important character
Gives a reason based on the scene, e.g. she calls the meeting, makes the speech and asks the men for a promise
summary: At sunset the group meets with Mrs. Harker, because sunrise and sunset are times when she is free of the Count's control
She says the poison in her blood may destroy her, but she will not take the way out of dying now
She asks the men what they will give her and asks them to promise that they will kill her if the time comes
Quincey seems to understand her and nods before she says the request plainly
